boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of North Texas
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food destinations on or near UNT with directly verified late availability.

cards.title: Chick-fil-A at the University Union
cards.subtitle: University Union, UNT campus
cards.notes: Use the University Union location when you need an on-campus food option later in the evening; verify holiday or break changes before heading over.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus option with service listed through 11 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.evidence_claim: UNT Dining lists Chick-fil-A in the University Union open Monday through Thursday from 7:30 a.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Current UNT Dining listing: Monday–Thursday, 7:30 a.m.–11 p.m.; Friday, 7:30 a.m.–10 p.m.; Saturday, 10 a.m.–10 p.m.

cards.title: Burger King at the University Union
cards.subtitle: Level 2, University Union, UNT campus
cards.notes: Keep this Level 2 Union counter in mind for an on-campus evening meal; check the dining page again when the academic calendar changes.
cards.short_summary: A University Union counter listed until 10 p.m. on weekdays.
cards.evidence_claim: UNT Dining lists the Level 2 Burger King open Monday through Friday from 7:30 a.m. to 10 p.m., with Saturday service until 9 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Current UNT Dining listing: Monday–Friday, 7:30 a.m.–10 p.m.; Saturday, 11 a.m.–9 p.m.

cards.title: Which Wich at The Market by Clark Bakery
cards.subtitle: Northwest corner of Eagle Landing, UNT campus
cards.notes: Head to the Market beside Eagle Landing for a sandwich option after daytime counters have closed; the listed schedule changes by day.
cards.short_summary: A campus sandwich counter listed until 10 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.evidence_claim: UNT Dining lists Which Wich at The Market by Clark Bakery open Monday through Thursday from 10 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Current UNT Dining listing: Monday–Thursday, 10 a.m.–10 p.m.; Friday, 10 a.m.–9 p.m.; Sunday, 2–9 p.m.

cards.title: The Market by Clark Bakery
cards.subtitle: Northwest corner of Eagle Landing, UNT campus
cards.notes: Use this campus market for a late evening food or snack purchase near Eagle Landing, and consult UNT Dining for closure-period adjustments.
cards.short_summary: A campus market listed through 10 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.evidence_claim: UNT Dining lists The Market by Clark Bakery open Monday through Thursday from 7:30 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Current UNT Dining listing: Monday–Thursday, 7:30 a.m.–10 p.m.; Friday, 7:30 a.m.–9 p.m.; Sunday, 2–9 p.m.

cards.title: Eagle Landing
cards.subtitle: UNT campus
cards.notes: Plan a dinner visit at this campus dining hall when its evening meal period fits your schedule; access and payment options vary by visitor status.
cards.short_summary: A UNT dining hall with evening service listed until 9 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.evidence_claim: UNT Dining lists Eagle Landing open Monday through Thursday from 4 p.m. to 9 p.m. for its evening service period.
cards.access_notes: Current UNT Dining listing: evening service Monday–Thursday, 4–9 p.m.; Friday, 4–8 p.m.; Saturday–Sunday, 4:30–8 p.m.

cards.title: Malone & University Whataburger
cards.subtitle: 1701 Malone St, Denton, TX 76201
cards.notes: Choose this nearby location when a 24-hour drive-thru or dine-in option suits your plans; confirm holiday exceptions on the location page.
cards.short_summary: A Denton Whataburger whose official page lists both dine-in and drive-thru service 24 hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger’s official location page lists the Malone Street restaurant’s dine-in and drive-thru service as 24 hours daily.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists drive-thru and dine-in as 24 hr Monday–Sunday; it notes holiday hours might differ.

cards.title: Jack in the Box on West University Drive
cards.subtitle: 328 W University Dr, Denton, TX 76201
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru at this West University location for a very late food pickup; the official page lists an overnight operating window.
cards.short_summary: A West University Drive drive-thru listed through 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box’s official page for 328 W University Drive lists drive-thru hours through 4 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 328 W University Dr, Denton
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists drive-thru hours of 4 a.m.–4 a.m. daily and describes the location as open until 4 a.m.

cards.title: IHOP on North Interstate 35
cards.subtitle: 3200 N Interstate 35, Denton, TX 76201
cards.notes: Use this diner-style option when you need a meal at an unusual hour; its official location page lists round-the-clock restaurant availability.
cards.short_summary: A Denton IHOP whose official location page lists every day as open 24 hours.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP’s official Denton location page lists restaurant hours as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists restaurant hours as open 24 hours Monday–Sunday.

cards.title: Austin Street Truck Stop
cards.subtitle: 208 N Austin St, Denton, TX 76201
cards.notes: Check the truck calendar before leaving, then select from the vendors operating that night; the park lists late service but truck schedules vary.
cards.short_summary: A Denton food-truck park that lists daily operation until 2 a.m., weather permitting.
cards.evidence_claim: Austin Street Truck Stop’s official site lists the park at 208 N Austin Street open 11 a.m.–2 a.m. seven days a week, weather permitting.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists the park open 11 a.m.–2 a.m. daily, weather permitting; individual food-truck schedules vary and are posted on its calendar.

cards.title: Fuzzy's Taco Shop on Industrial Street
cards.subtitle: 115 Industrial St, Denton, TX 76201
cards.notes: Use the Industrial Street shop for a Friday or Saturday late meal, and choose take-out or dine-in based on the options listed for this location.
cards.short_summary: A Denton taco shop listed until midnight on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Fuzzy’s Taco Shop’s official Denton (Industrial) page lists Friday and Saturday shop hours from 7 a.m. to midnight.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists Friday and Saturday, 7 a.m.–midnight; Thursday, 7 a.m.–11 p.m.; other days close earlier.
